Androscoggin County Sheriff’s Office and Auburn Police Department are investigating the crash that started when a deputy attempted to stop the vehicle for an alleged traffic violation, according to William Gagne, chief deputy for Androscoggin County. The driver of the vehicle failed to stop in Poland near the Minot line about 10:45 p.m., Gagne said, and kept going into Auburn. Along the 1600 block of Minot Avenue near the John Deere dealership, it appeared the driver lost control of the vehicle, which went off the road and rolled over. A female in the vehicle was taken to Central Maine Medical Center in Lewiston by Auburn Fire Rescue Department personnel and later taken to Maine Medical Center in Portland with serious, possibly life-threatening injuries, Gagne said. Authorities released no additional information as of early Tuesday evening. County deputies and Auburn police continue to investigate the incident, Gagne said. Donna M. Perry Staff Writer Donna M.
